svg.title: Artha capture and metadata architecture
svg.desc: Grounded natural-language capture, clarification, reviewed metadata and atomic confirmation, with no write before review.

g.text: One primary path, one safe clarification branch, and a visible review checkpoint.
Grounded interpretation creates an unsaved draft; nothing here writes to the ledger
Original sentence stays intact for manual recovery and reparse.
ONLY WHEN A REQUIRED FIELD IS MISSING
Ask one grounded question; use choices from the person’s own accounts, categories or participants
Append choice to the exact text
A person can correct every value before the idempotent atomic write
Rules first • safe catalog next • grounded model evidence last
